data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for Apple's on-device Foundation Models framework and Apple Intelligence.
data.what_it_does: Integrates with Apple's Foundation Models framework on iOS and macOS to provide session-based language model interactions. Supports token streaming, persistent context, generation options, and content safety guardrails entirely on-device.
use_when: You are building an iOS or macOS app that leverages Apple Intelligence on-device models
You need local, privacy-first language model chat sessions with streaming responses
avoid_when: You need cross-platform support for Android or Windows
Target devices do not support iOS 26.0+ or macOS 15.0+ with Apple Intelligence enabled
strengths: On-device processing ensures privacy with no external server costs
Supports persistent multi-turn chat sessions and real-time token streaming
Includes built-in content safety guardrails and session pre-warming
weaknesses: Restricted only to Apple platforms (iOS 26.0+ / macOS 15.0+)
Requires physical devices with Apple Intelligence enabled and models downloaded
data.setup_notes: Requires setting iOS deployment target to 26.0+, enabling Apple Intelligence in macOS system settings, and ensuring compatible hardware.
